deployment_assumptions: Multi-agent analysis includes device physics, adversarial threats, lifecycle risks, and manufacturing considerations

security_requirements.requirement: The design shall employ oxide barriers or deep trench isolation to ensure substrate noise is minimized.
security_requirements.title: Transistor Isolation Techniques
security_requirements.verification_method: Simulation and physical testing of EM interference at design phase.

security_requirements.requirement: The design shall use gate materials with verified high endurance to hot carrier injection.
security_requirements.title: Gate Oxide Reliability
security_requirements.verification_method: High-stress endurance testing and aging simulation.

security_requirements.requirement: The manufacturing process shall adhere strictly to electron flow tolerances in interconnects to prevent atom migration.
security_requirements.title: Robust Interconnect Design
security_requirements.verification_method: Current density modeling and lifetime expectation testing.
